axes.model_access:
**It calls no model itself** — an interface implementation called by MCP clients. It wraps Neon's (serverless Postgres)
management API and database operations as tools for agents.
axes.runtime:
A local process (npx stdio) + an official hosted remote line; GitHub 659★, last push 2026-10-29 (API verified).
The old docs path (neon.com/docs/ai-and-mcp/mcp-server) direct-fetched 404 — the current line is the repo itself.
axes.local_files: Reads and writes no local project files — the scope is Neon cloud projects/branches and databases.
axes.background: stdio lives and dies with the client; Neon's branch capability is its signature — an agent can create database branches for isolated experiments.
axes.tools:
Project management, branch create/delete, database query execution, schema inspection, etc.; write capabilities are complete
(create branches, execute SQL). The complete inventory follows the repo README.
axes.context: No cross-session memory — state lives in the Neon project itself.
axes.fit:
Fits: agent dev flows for the Neon stack (create branch→try changes→merge), hooking serverless Postgres management into an agent.
Not a fit: non-Neon Postgres (it manages its own platform); hard read-only boundaries.

mcp.transport:
**stdio** (npx) is primary + an official hosted remote line (details follow the repo README, not verified item by item).
Verified: the repo and GitHub API (2026-10-21).
mcp.auth: Two routes: Neon API key (management surface) + Postgres connection string (data surface).
mcp.scope:
Management surface: project/branch add/delete/query; data surface: SQL execution (including writes/DDL).
No official docs for a tool-level approval mechanism; the branch model is a structural isolation means, not an approval layer.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The test protocol is at [protocols/mcp/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/mcp/_protocol.md).
unknowns:
- The status of the hosted remote endpoint (not verified item by item)
- The full tool inventory (not enumerated item by item)
- Details of product-wording changes after the Databricks acquisition (not verified item by item — the vendor line follows the current official owner)
related: Both BaaS database servers: Supabase's project surface is broader, Neon's branch isolation is the structural differentiator.
